##### Project general facts

Pelagia is a refined waterfront development on Al Marjan Island, where contemporary architecture is shaped by the fluid elegance of the sea. The project offers a curated selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, alongside exclusive 4-bedroom penthouses with private pools. Its design is defined by sweeping, wave-inspired balconies and graceful lines that create a sense of movement, while expansive glazing and open layouts fill each residence with natural light, delivering a calm and sophisticated coastal living experience.

Residents enjoy a thoughtfully curated range of resort-style amenities designed for both relaxation and active living. A rooftop infinity pool with panoramic views, jacuzzi, and a fully equipped gym create a wellness-focused environment, complemented by yoga spaces, steam and sauna facilities. Family-friendly features including kids’ pools, splash areas, and indoor and outdoor play zones ensure a balanced lifestyle, while social spaces such as the rooftop pool bar, viewing deck, and BBQ areas offer perfect settings for leisure and connection.

Interiors are finished with modern high-quality materials, creating a clean and elegant aesthetic throughout. Kitchens come fully equipped with built-in appliances, combining functionality with contemporary design. Residences are offered fully furnished, providing a seamless move-in experience where every detail is thoughtfully designed to reflect comfort, style, and refined beachfront living.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. It is one of the most prominent tourist destinations in the region, known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. Al Marjan Island is situated along the Arabian Gulf coastline and offers breathtaking views of the sea. The island is shaped like a coral reef and is made up of four primary coral-shaped islands, connected by a central boulevard.

One of the main highlights of Al Marjan Island is its pristine white sandy beaches that stretch across 5.4 kilometers. Visitors can indulge in various beach activities, including sunbathing, swimming, and water sports such as jet skiing and paddleboarding. The crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf provide an ideal setting for water enthusiasts.

Al Marjan Island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts, offering world-class amenities and services. These accommodations cater to both leisure and business travelers, providing a range of options to suit different preferences and budgets. Many of the hotels and resorts on the island feature stunning architecture and provide access to private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options.
